race.comment: AMAZAKE (1) returns after a six-month spell. Class runner whose peak rating last prep came when a close fourth second-up in the Group 2 Alister Clark over 2000m at Caulfield. Just missed first-up when last in work over this distance at Pakenham. Sure to run another big race while fresh. The race-fit LIGULARIA (6) is the danger at the fourth start of the campaign. Led and gave a great sight but found one better over 1550m at Canterbury last time out. Won't spend a cent from the inside gate and this looks a lovely race for her. LET'S BE HONEST (5) started at huge odds but was beaten under a length recently over 1400m at Hawkesbury. Progressing nicely and the step up to 1600m is a positive move. FLY THE WIND (4) made it three minor placings from her last four when beaten in a photo over the mile at Goulburn in Class 1 company last start. That form should measure up. SHOCAIR (8) has not raced for seven weeks but did impress at Goulburn at her latest appearance when fresh from a spell.
